annotations.text:
The waitlist form works: type an address with an @ and press Join to see the confirmed state. Both artboards keep their own state.

Copy is drawn from the app itself — the empty-state headline, the four features, original_pdfs/, the endpoint warning. The GitHub and Releases links are placeholders.
Same page at 390px — the hero stacks, the feature grid becomes one column, and the waitlist field and button go full width.
